title: Punctured Wilson--Evolving Sets and Root Identities for Massive Kirchhoff Forests
summary: We construct a punctured Wilson--evolving-set coupling for finite reversible Markov chains. The transformed evolving set carries a Markov trajectory up to its exit from a punctured domain, whereas the ordinary evolving set gives the corresponding probabilities after de-biasing. Applied to Wilson's algorithm with exponential killing, the final-point projection yields the root law and an ordered factorization of the probability that several prescribed vertices are roots. We identify this factorization with a probabilistic Schur-complement decomposition of the known determinantal root formula.…
